tut1_title: Welcome to the Gate of Haewon!
tut1_content:
This is the Gate between the living and the dead.
Become a Master, purify the resentful spirits,
and guide their souls to ascension!
tut2_content:
Long press a tower icon at the bottom,
then drag it onto a green placement slot.

Towers cost Spirit(⚡) to build.
Good placement gives you a strategic advantage!
tut3_content:
🔥 Fire Beacon — AoE attack
💧 Water Spring — Slow/Debuff
🌿 Wood Shrine — Multi-hit
⚔️ Metal Bell — Heavy single hit
🪨 Earth Altar — Summon soldiers

Element synergy is the key to strategy!
tut4_content:
☀️ During day, Fire & Wood towers are stronger.
🌙 At night, Water & Metal towers are stronger
  and stealth enemies appear.
⏳ During transitions, Earth towers are boosted.

Place towers according to time of day!
tut5_content:
Defeating enemies drops spirit orbs
that auto-purify for Spirit resources!

⚠️ If purification falls behind, the "Wailing"
gauge rises, weakening towers. At 100%,
all enemies go berserk!
tut6_content:
Heroes auto-attack enemies in range
and skills activate when off cooldown.

💡 Tap a hero to trigger skill instantly!
Drag to reposition them.

Ready? Let the battle begin!
